# American Red Cross

> The American Red Cross provides disaster relief, blood donation services, CPR training, and volunteer opportunities across 200+ U.S. locations with transparent donor engagement programs.

The American Red Cross (Cruz Roja Americana) is a humanitarian organization offering emergency response, health and safety training, blood services, and multiple donation pathways. The site supports account management, recurring giving programs, and major gift opportunities including planned giving and specialized donor recognition societies.

## Key Topics

- Disaster Relief
- Blood Donation Services
- CPR and First Aid Training
- Monthly Giving
- Planned Giving
- Donor Transparency
- Account Management
- Clara Barton Giving Society
- Local Chapters
- Charitable Giving Methods
- Major Gifts
- Emergency Response
- Volunteer Services
- Tax Benefits
- Donation Impact

## Core Services & Locations

- [American Red Cross Homepage](https://www.redcross.org): American Red Cross homepage showcasing disaster relief, blood donation, CPR, and volunteer services.
- [Cruz Roja Americana](https://www.redcross.org/cruz-roja.html): Spanish-language homepage for Cruz Roja Americana disaster relief and services.
- [Find Your Local Red Cross Chapter](https://www.redcross.org/find-your-local-chapter.html): Locator tool for finding Red Cross chapters across 200+ U.S. locations.

## Donation Methods & Programs

- [Monthly Giving Program](https://www.redcross.org/donations/ways-to-donate/monthly-giving.html): Guide to Red Cross monthly giving program and recurring donation benefits.
- [Text, Mail & Phone Donations](https://www.redcross.org/donations/ways-to-donate/text-mail-phone.html): Instructions for donating via text, mail, or phone to American Red Cross.
- [Major Gifts & Donation Levels](https://www.redcross.org/donations/ways-to-donate/donation-and-engage.html): Overview of major gift donation levels and donor recognition programs.
- [Clara Barton Giving Society](https://www.redcross.org/donations/ways-to-donate/donation-and-engage/clara-barton-giving-society.html): Clara Barton Giving Society membership and philanthropic program details.
- [Planned Giving & Legacy Gifts](https://www.redcross.org/donations/ways-to-donate/planned-giving.html): Guide to planned giving, legacy gifts, and estate planning with Red Cross.
- [Stock & Wire Transfer Donations](https://www.redcross.org/donations/ways-to-donate/stocks-mutual-funds.html): Instructions for donating stocks, mutual funds, and wire transfers.
- [Donor-Advised Funds (DAF)](https://www.redcross.org/donations/ways-to-donate/donor-advised-funds.html): Guide to donor-advised fund contributions and Red Cross beneficiary setup.
- [Qualified Charitable IRA Distributions](https://www.redcross.org/donations/ways-to-donate/qualified-charitable-distributions.html): Instructions for qualified charitable IRA distributions to Red Cross.
- [Vehicle Donations](https://www.redcross.org/donations/ways-to-donate/car-donations.html): Guide to vehicle donation process through Red Cross partner CARS.

## Account Management

- [Sign In](https://www.redcross.org/sign-in.html): Authentication and login page for Red Cross account access.
- [Account Summary](https://www.redcross.org/account.html/my-account/account-summary): Account summary page for managing Red Cross user profiles and donation history.
- [Donation History](https://www.redcross.org/account.html/my-account/donations): Donation history and management interface for Red Cross account holders.
- [Monthly Giving Management](https://www.redcross.org/account.html/my-account/monthly-giving): Monthly giving program management and recurring donation settings.
- [Personal Information Settings](https://www.redcross.org/account.html/my-account/personal-information): Personal information management and account configuration for Red Cross users.

## Donor Impact & Transparency

- [Where Your Money Goes](https://www.redcross.org/donations/where-your-money-goes.html): Donation transparency report showing Red Cross spending and impact metrics.

## Optional Resources

- [Charity Streaming & Gaming Fundraise](https://www.redcross.org/donations/ways-to-donate/play-games-and-fundraise.html): Instructions for charity streaming and gaming fundraising for Red Cross.
